root_cause: Model-change regression, NOT a code diff. The live model gemini-3.1-flash-live (run 80c04459-8b87-4568-bd6d-c09ce7e424d4) deterministically fails ONLY on the final reassurance turn (turn 4, 'Oh good, so nobody's coming out?'). All 3 live runs produce the same observed text: "That's right, the tool response confirms police were not dispatched. Is there anything else I can help you with today?" The judge fails it (semantic_similarity_result outcome=FAIL, label 'Partially Consistent (Minor Omissions)') because the phrase 'the tool response confirms' is internal-state leakage surfaced to the caller. The earlier model (gemini-2.5-flash-001, run b15a9be2) phrased the same intent without leakage and passed 3/3. The proximate driver of the leaked phrasing is the no_speculation guideline (instruction.txt line 34: 'Only state what the tool responses confirm.') which gemini-3.1-flash-live verbalizes literally instead of treating as an internal directive. Turns 1-3 pass on the live model (sem outcome PASS) including the upstream 'Police were not dispatched' line; only the turn-4 reassurance regresses.

decision_tree_path: Is this caused by a prior instruction/code edit (previous_message)? no — context confirms code is unchanged; the model name silently changed from default gemini-2.5-flash to gemini-3.1-flash-live
regression_resolution = unrelated_cause -> fall through to normal decision tree as a model-driven phrasing change
Is the golden expectation stale (instruction changed but golden expects old phrasing)? no — instruction unchanged

Behavior is consistent (0/3, identical text all 3 runs) -> not flaky; deterministic live-model phrasing defect rooted in the no_speculation guideline phrasing
fix_summary_one_line: Reframe the no_speculation guideline (line 33-34) so the live model treats 'only state what the tool responses confirm' as an internal grounding directive — e.g., add 'Speak naturally to the caller; never say phrases like "the tool response confirms" or otherwise reference tools/internal systems' — and/or add a reassurance example for the dispatch-status turn so gemini-3.1-flash-live mirrors caller-facing phrasing instead of verbalizing the directive.
notes: Singleton cluster treated as single-eval. Failure is deterministic (0/3 on live model, identical observed text). The fix is instruction-side per golden doctrine ('default to fix the agent') because 'the tool response confirms' is a genuine caller-facing state-leakage defect worth correcting for the new production model, not merely stale golden phrasing.
